# Upscaler AI vs. Gigapixel iOS App

## Overview

Both **Upscaler AI** and **Gigapixel iOS** are advanced AI-powered photo enhancement apps available on iOS, designed to upscale and restore low-quality images. Below is a detailed comparison to help you choose the best tool for your needs.

---

## Feature Comparison

| Feature                      | Upscaler AI                                   | Gigapixel iOS (Topaz Labs)                  |
|------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------|
| **Core Functionality**       | Upscales, restores, and enhances photos       | AI upscaling, face recovery, detail restoration |
| **AI Face Enhancement**      | Yes                                           | Yes (advanced, with Face Recovery Gen2)     |
| **Old Photo Restoration**    | Yes                                           | Yes                                         |
| **Batch Processing**         | Not specified                                 | Yes (Pro/Desktop version)                   |
| **Processing Location**      | On device                                     | On device (“Just Faces”) & Cloud (“Everything”) |
| **Offline Use**              | Yes                                           | Yes (for “Just Faces” mode)                 |
| **Free Tier**                | Free download, limited features               | Free for “Just Faces” local mode, 100 free cloud credits for “Everything” mode [1] |
| **Subscription/Pricing**     | Weekly: $4.99, 1,000 credits: $49.99          | Standard: $14.99/mo or $7.49/mo billed annually (16MP); Premium: $49.99/mo or $39.99/mo billed annually (64MP) [2] |
| **Supported Resolutions**    | Not specified                                 | Up to 4x upscaling, 16MP/64MP output [2]    |
| **Languages**                | English, Japanese, Spanish                    | English                                     |
| **Privacy**                  | No data collected                             | Not specified, but local processing available [3][1] |

---

## Upscaler AI Highlights

- **Purpose:** Designed for restoring old, blurry, or damaged photos and upscaling low-resolution images with a single tap [3].
- **User Experience:** Focuses on simplicity and quick results, suitable for users wanting fast, share-ready enhancements.
- **Subscription Model:** Offers weekly and credit-based plans for enhanced features [3].
- **Compatibility:** Works on iPhone, iPad, iPod touch (iOS 15+), and Mac (M1+), with support for multiple languages [3].
- **Data Privacy:** Developer claims no data is collected from users [3].

---

## Gigapixel iOS Highlights

- **Purpose:** Professional-grade AI upscaling, restoration, and face recovery, trusted by commercial users and organizations [2][1].
- **AI Models:** Offers two modes—“Just Faces” (local, free), and “Everything” (cloud, paid) for full-image enhancement [1].
- **Output Quality:** Recognized for retaining realistic detail, especially in faces and textures, with industry-leading results [2][1].
- **User Experience:** Highly rated for quality and flexibility; “Just Faces” is fast and private, while “Everything” provides top-tier results at the cost of cloud credits [4][1].
- **Pricing:** Offers a generous free tier (100 credits for new users), with monthly and annual unlimited plans for higher resolutions [2].
- **Reputation:** Used by professionals and major organizations (NASA, Google, Tesla, etc.) [1].

---

## User Reviews & Experience

### Upscaler AI

- **Strengths:** Simple interface, quick results, good for casual users and restoring family photos [3].
- **Limitations:** Advanced features require subscription or credits; output quality may not match professional-grade tools [3].

### Gigapixel iOS

- **Strengths:** Superior detail recovery, especially for faces; flexible local/cloud processing; praised for outperforming competitors like Remini [4][1].
- **Limitations:** Full-image enhancement (“Everything” mode) requires cloud credits or subscription; some features only available online [1].

---

## Summary Table

| Criteria           | Upscaler AI              | Gigapixel iOS              |
|--------------------|-------------------------|----------------------------|
| Best For           | Quick, easy enhancements| Professional-grade results |
| Pricing            | Lower entry, pay-per-use| Free local, paid cloud/unlimited |
| Output Quality     | Good for most users     | Industry-leading, pro-level|
| Privacy            | No data collected       | Local mode for privacy     |
| Flexibility        | Simpler, fewer options  | Multiple modes, more control|

---

## Conclusion

- **Choose Upscaler AI** if you want a straightforward, easy-to-use app for restoring and upscaling family photos or social media images, and you value privacy and simplicity [3].
- **Choose Gigapixel iOS** if you need the highest possible quality, advanced face recovery, or professional-grade upscaling, and are willing to pay for premium features. Its local mode is free and private, while the cloud mode unlocks the full power of Topaz’s AI models [2][1][4].

---
